jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Franchise FastLane is the #1 Franchise Sales Organization in the country and a multi-time Inc. 5000 honoree.

We are a franchise growth partner that guides entrepreneurs and founders from concept to exit. We help individuals find the right brand to own, help founders build franchise systems that others can own, and give established franchisors the strategy, talent, and technology to expand with confidence.

One team, one system, and a shared focus on building lasting enterprise value.

**The Role:**

The Brand Onboarding Specialist owns the end-to-end onboarding and launch process for new franchise brands entering the Franchise FastLane platform.

This role serves as the central point of coordination between franchisors and internal Sales, Marketing, Operations, Compliance, and Leadership teams. The Brand Onboarding Specialist is responsible for ensuring every brand is fully prepared, properly positioned, operationally ready, and launched successfully.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously. They are skilled at gathering complex information, creating structure, driving accountability, and ensuring projects move forward efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Brand Onboarding & Launch Management***

· Take ownership of new franchise brands immediately following contract execution and internal handoff.

· Serve as the primary point of contact for franchisors throughout the onboarding process.

· Lead onboarding kickoff meetings and establish launch timelines, deliverables, expectations, and responsibilities.

· Maintain the master onboarding plan and ensure all stakeholders meet agreed-upon deadlines.

· Identify onboarding risks, missing information, and launch barriers and drive timely resolution.

***Brand Information & Documentation Management***

· Collect, organize, and maintain required brand information, documentation, and launch assets.

· Ensure documentation is complete, accurate, and accessible to internal stakeholders.

· Coordinate collection of franchise-related materials, including:

o Current FDD and franchise agreements

o Financial performance representations (Item 19)

o Franchise fees and investment information

o Territory requirements and availability

o Franchisee validation contacts

o Candidate qualification criteria

o Discovery and sales process information

o Marketing assets and brand materials

· Escalate legal or compliance-related questions to appropriate internal leaders or franchise counsel.

***Coordinate Development of the Internal Brand Playbook***

· Coordinate the development of internal brand resources used by Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams.

· Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure brand positioning, candidate profiles, competitive differentiators, candidate journey information, and consultant-facing resources are accurately documented.

· Ensure internal teams have the information necessary to confidently represent and support each brand.

***Marketing Launch Readiness***

· Partner with Marketing to ensure launch requirements are completed and approved on schedule.

· Coordinate collection and delivery of required inputs for:

o Landing pages

o CRM campaign setup

o Lead routing

o Marketing assets

o Consultant-facing materials

o Tracking and attribution requirements

· Ensure marketing readiness remains aligned with overall launch timelines.

***Sales Launch Readiness***

· Coordinate sales readiness activities prior to launch.

· Schedule brand training sessions and franchisor introductions.

· Confirm lead routing, CRM configuration, and availability of sales materials.

· Track and resolve outstanding questions, action items, and launch dependencies.

· Ensure development teams are prepared to represent brands accurately and confidently before launch.

***Cross-Functional Launch Coordination***

· Serve as the primary coordinator across Sales, Marketing, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and franchisor teams.

· Maintain visibility into timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and outstanding items.

· Facilitate communication and accountability among stakeholders.

· Escalate issues requiring leadership support or intervention.

***Launch Readiness & Final Review***

· Conduct formal launch readiness reviews prior to activation.

· Validate that operational, sales, marketing, and brand requirements have been completed.

· Assess launch risks and provide launch recommendations to leadership.

· Recommend GO / HOLD decisions when requirements have not been satisfied.

***Post-Launch Transition***

· Coordinate the transition of newly launched brands to their ongoing account owner.

· Transfer documentation, contacts, commitments, and relationship history.

· Document outstanding items and ensure appropriate ownership.

· Support resolution of onboarding-related issues identified immediately following launch.

***Process Improvement & Optimization***

· Identify recurring onboarding issues, bottlenecks, launch delays, and process gaps.

· Recommend and support process, system, automation, and workflow improvements.

· Contribute to continuous improvement efforts that increase onboarding efficiency, consistency, and scalability.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

* Strong attention to detail while maintaining focus on broader project objectives.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting sales and marketing launch initiatives.
* Experience with CRM and project management platforms such as HubSpot, Monday.com, Salesforce, or Microsoft 365.

jobs.title: Onboarding Technician
jobs.description:
**About Lumistry**

Lumistry began as a phone system for independent pharmacies and grew, product by product, into the communication and workflow platform those pharmacies run on today. Each addition answered a problem pharmacists told us about: phones that never stop ringing, education that gets thrown away, patients who drift to the chains.

Today, Lumistry serves more than 9,000 pharmacies with technology built for pharmacy. Our solutions help pharmacies engage patients, automate work, improve health literacy, reduce operating costs, and grow their businesses. Now we are using AI to take repetitive work off pharmacy teams so they can spend more time with patients.

**The Opportunity**

You know how much of the day goes to repetitive tasks in the pharmacy management system (PMS), like processing refills and entering e-scripts. Our AI-powered automation does that work for the pharmacy team.

As an Onboarding Technician, you instruct an automation agent on how each pharmacy works. You map out each task step by step, think through every “if this happens, then do that,” build it in our workflow builder, and keep it running smoothly once it goes live. The job sits between two worlds. On one side are pharmacy technicians who know their PMS cold but do not think in terms of automation logic. On the other is an automation that will do exactly what you tell it, in exactly the order you tell it, and will stop when reality does not match what you wrote.

Your job is to turn the first into the second, prove it works, and fix it fast when it breaks.

**What You'll Do**

* Set up new pharmacies on our platform and make sure the device that runs their automation is connected and ready.
* Meet with pharmacy teams, learn how they work in their PMS, and map each task step by step, including the decisions and exceptions along the way.
* Build, test, and update automated workflows in our workflow builder for each PMS we support.
* Work with our engineers on the technical pieces, like how the automation recognizes PMS screens and fields, and confirm everything works in the pharmacy.
* Check automation runs every day, figure out why something stopped or failed, and fix it.
* Update workflows when a PMS releases a new version.
* Help grow a library of proven workflow templates so each new pharmacy goes live faster.
* Escalate issues you cannot solve, with screenshots, the step that failed, and what you have already tried.

**What You Bring**

* Pharmacy experience using a pharmacy management system (PMS).
* Logical, critical thinking. You can break a process into steps, think through every “if this, then that,” and figure out why something works nine times out of 10 but fails on the tenth.
* The ability to interview pharmacy staff about how they work: ask follow-up questions, catch the steps they skip because they are second nature, and confirm what you heard.
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write instructions others can follow and can calmly explain an issue to a pharmacy.

**Other Details**

* Business hours across U.S. time zones, with occasional after-hours work for go-lives, PMS updates, and a shared on-call rotation as we grow.
* Occasional travel to pharmacies to set up devices and see workflows firsthand.
* You will be trained on our tools and workflows, and your skills in automation and AI will grow with the product.

**Compensation**

The approximate range for this role is $70,000 to $75,000.

### **Benefits**

Lumistry offers a comprehensive benefits package, including flexible time off; medical, dental, and vision coverage; long-term disability coverage; fitness benefits; and more.

### **Diversity and Inclusion at Lumistry**

Lumistry is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to an inclusive workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This commitment applies to every part of employment, from recruiting and hiring to compensation and promotion. We base our decisions solely on qualifications, merit, and current business needs.

### **Accessibility**

We're happy to provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities during the application and interview process. If you need assistance, please reach out.

jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist (Google Marketing Tools and Tracking)
jobs.description:
Do you love working in the digital marketing industry?

Do you enjoy the technical side of marketing (setting up Google Tag Manager containers, wiring up conversion tracking, and making sure every call, form fill, and purchase gets counted before a single ad dollar is spent)?

If you answered YES to these questions and you are:

* someone who loves building things right the first time (i.e., clean tag setups, clear naming conventions and solid documentation);
* highly organized and detail-obsessed, the kind of person who notices when a conversion fires twice;
* great at working with clients, and can explain technical steps in plain, friendly language;
* driven by opportunities to learn more and grow your skills and experiences, and by contributing successes for the team and the clients;
* always curious about the world around you, having an elaborate growth mindset;

Read on, as we are looking for a "**Tracking & Tagging Wizard**", and this role may be just for you.

**OUR COMPANY**

**Fast + Light** is one of the fastest growing digital marketing agencies in and out of Los Angeles. We've been in business as an agency for over 10 years, and we aim to guide our clients towards their measurable success. Our company operates on not only "fixing", but also into helping our clients understand the mechanics on how we actually bring in sales into their company.

Think of us as mechanics for their revenue engine.

Only, we don't just sell the dream and shiny new parts - we guide our clients through the technical stuff and give the tools to fix the leaky sales funnel.

Tactics and methods in the digital marketing world constantly change, but our client-first results-driven business principles don't.

**THE POSITION**

**Fast + Light** is seeking a detail-oriented and technically sharp **Onboarding & Tracking Specialist with expertise in Google Tag Manager and Tracking Setup**, who can get our new clients set up correctly from day one so our ads team can launch with confidence.

As you work with a team that brings scalable success to some of the top names in health and wellness, fashion and home goods, as well as local businesses, selling products, services, and online courses through various social media platforms and Google advertising, your key responsibilities to fulfill this position are:

* Leading new clients through onboarding: gathering account access, assets and business information, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between contract signing and campaign launch;
* Setting up, auditing, and fixing tracking (Google Tag Manager containers, GA4 properties, Google Ads conversion tracking, Meta Pixel and Conversions API) so every key action is measured accurately;
* Documenting each client's setup and handing it off cleanly to our media buyers and account managers.

One of our visions as a company is to create a world where businesses-- however big or small, and as long as they have the idea and run with the same passion as ours-- get the chance to grow profitably as they help people through their products and/or services.

As we help them grow, we help their customers get products and/or services that they need, and at the same time contribute creating more jobs as our clients' businesses flourish to growth, scalability, and, above all, profitability. The work you'll contribute to our team is greatly valued as we recognize that this will help us achieve these goals with our clients.

Oh! Also before we forget, this is a **part-time position that can grow into a full-time** position quickly. And, you can fulfill your work at the comfort of your own home or literally anywhere around the world as we follow a **fully remote** working location.

We are a relaxed and friendly team, with a fun and casual relationship with most of our clients, though performance and passion for the craft of online advertising is at the core of everything we do. No matter what your background is, if you are willing to bring the wins and successes we aim for our clients, and willing to learn the ins and outs of the industry, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

**THE PREREQUISITES**

Before anything else, we'd like to give you a sneak-peek of the actual responsibilities of the role (aside from the aforementioned):

* Run onboarding calls to collect logins, permissions and brand assets, and follow up until everything is in.
* Secure and organize access to Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, Google Merchant Center, Meta Business Manager and the client's website or e-commerce platform (e.g., Shopify, WordPress).
* Create new GTM containers or audit existing ones, implement and organize tags, triggers, and variables using clear naming conventions.
* Set up GA4 properties, data streams and key events, and link GA4 with Google Ads and Search Console.
* Implement conversion tracking for form submissions, purchases, phone calls, button clicks and chats, including Enhanced Conversions where applicable.
* Install and verify the Meta Pixel and Conversions API, plus other platform tags as needed (e.g., Microsoft UET, TikTok, LinkedIn).
* Configure call tracking (e.g., CallRail, WhatConverts) and connect it to Google Ads and GA4.
* Work with data events and ecommerce tracking, and set up cross-domain tracking where needed.
* QA every setup before launch using GTM Preview/Tag Assistant, GA4 DebugView and Meta Events Manager.
* Set up consent mode and cookie-consent tools where a client requires them.
* Maintain onboarding checklists, SOPs, and per-client tracking documentation, and troubleshoot tracking issues after launch.
* Keep media buyers, creatives and account managers updated on each client's onboarding status.
* Maintaining tracking events and resolve ongoing tracking issues and errors

Our dream candidate would be someone who:

* Has at least 2 years of hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager and GA4, ideally within a digital marketing agency
* Has proven experience setting up conversion tracking for Google Ads and Meta Ads (forms, calls, purchases)
* Has a solid understanding of the tags, triggers, variables, and debugging tools
* Is familiar with ad account structures, user access and permissions in Google Ads Manager (MCC) and Meta Business Manager
* Is comfortable working inside website platforms such as Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Wix or Squarespace, etc.
* Has strong organizational skills and can handle several client onboardings at the same time
* Has a keen eye and high attention to detail
* Has strong verbal and written communication skills, and is comfortable speaking with clients
* Has the ability work efficiently remotely and can manage/track time and tasks accordingly
* Has a passion for learning and staying at the forefront of digital marketing/advertising
* Is enthusiastic, passionate, and committed

Although not required, it would be a plus advantage to have the following:

* Bachelor's degree
* Google Analytics and/or Google Ads Certification
* Experience with server-side tracking (e.g., GTM server container, Stape)
* Basic HTML/JavaScript knowledge for custom tags and triggers
* Experience with Google Consent Mode v2 and cookie-consent platforms
* Experience building reporting dashboards (e.g., Looker Studio)
* Experience with CRMs and their integrations (e.g., GoHighLevel, HubSpot)

**THE COVERAGE**

**Job Type:** Part-time, Full-time

**Schedule:** 9AM to 5PM PST, Mondays to Fridays

**Experience:** Google Tag Manager & Tracking Setup (required)

**Work Location:** Fully Remote

**Salary:** Under negotiable terms

**INTERESTED TO APPLY?**

Send in the following files/documents so we can kick-start your hiring process:

* Updated resume or curriculum vitae
* Cover Letter
* 2-minute video introducing yourself
* A sample of a tracking setup you've done (screenshots, a short screen-recording walkthrough or a brief write-up)

Pay: $10.00 - $15.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 8.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Director of Onboarding
jobs.description:
Order.co is the System of Action for the Office of the CFO, transforming the way businesses purchase and pay into an intuitive, B2C-like shopping experience. Order.co leverages embedded AI agents and embedded financial products to reinvent the way businesses connect with their vendors.

End users enjoy a seamless, zero-training buying experience, while finance and procurement leaders gain a single platform to orchestrate how the business “should operate”. The result is an all-in-one solution that serves as a gravitational pull for spend and data, automating and eliminating procurement and finance workflows from requisition to reconciliation along the way.

Order.co is on the cutting edge of B2B Agentic Commerce, poised to be the market leader in creating a more predictive, prescriptive, and personalized experience for users.

Founded in 2016 and headquartered in New York City, Order.co oversees nearly half a billion in annualized spend across hundreds of customers like WeWork, SoulCycle, Lume, and [solidcore]. Order.co has raised $75M in funding from industry-leading investors like MIT, Stage 2 Capital, Rally Ventures, 645 Ventures, and more. Order.co has been proudly named a 50 to Watch by Spend Matters and a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn and Inc. Magazine.

Order.co is looking for a Director of Onboarding to lead how our new customers change the way they buy, and how fast they get there. Onboarding is the first real experience a customer has with us after signing, and every week between contract close and activation is spend that hasn’t moved to Order.co yet. As we grow across our core, partner, and enterprise channels, we need a leader who can oversee multiple customer rollouts at once, with a small but mighty team, without letting speed or quality slip.

This is a leadership role with a broad mandate, and it comes as we reshape what onboarding means at Order.co. Getting a customer live is only the start: this role owns changing how the customer buys. You and your team will move each customer forward by setting milestones with their leadership, driving user change management, rolling out and training across their locations, and ushering them through to fully ramped spend. You will partner closely with a dedicated setup team to ensure the customer experiences one seamless setup. You will own the setup & onboarding strategy and delivery across all three channels and lead a diverse team including individual contributors, team leads, and future people managers. Reporting to the VP of Customer Success, you will set the standard for what onboarding looks like at Order.co.

**What you’ll do**

* **Lead and develop the team.** Coach team members and leaders, establish clear responsibilities and career paths, and allocate projects based on capacity, complexity, and individual strengths.
* **Build scalable onboarding programs.** Define implementation tiers, milestones, and delivery standards across core, partner, and enterprise channels. Clarify ownership across Onboarding, Account Management, and Customer Success.
* **Drive customer rollout and change management.** Guide the team in building mutual success plans with clear dates, owners, and location rollout schedules. Engage executive sponsors, develop customer champions, and address missed commitments early.
* **Make adoption stick.** Build training and communication programs for admins, approvers, and requesters across hundreds of locations. Help customers transition purchasing from legacy channels to Order.co and measure success through sustained usage.
* **Own onboarding performance.** Track and improve time to activation against tier-specific SLAs, the share of booked spend reached within four months, location and user adoption, and CSAT.
* **Create seamless transitions.** Establish clear handoffs from Sales and Partnerships, coordinate configuration delivery with Operations, and transition customers to Customer Success once they meet defined onboarding exit criteria.
* **Guide the configuration transition.** Partner with Operations to define ownership, handoff requirements, and turnaround times as catalog setup, GL coding, spend history, and other configuration work move out of Onboarding.
* **Resolve complex projects.** Serve as the escalation point for at-risk implementations, particularly enterprise deployments, and step in directly when needed.
* **Improve how we work.** Turn customer and team insights into process improvements and Product priorities. Use AI and automation to reduce manual work, and carry improvements through rollout, adoption, and standardization.

**What we’re looking for**

* 5+ years of experience in implementation, customer success, or professional services in SaaS, eCommerce, or B2B, including 3+ years leading teams. Experience managing team leads or managers is a strong plus.
* Experience overseeing multiple concurrent implementations, from high-velocity SMB onboarding to complex enterprise and partner-led deployments.
* A track record of driving adoption across distributed, multi-location businesses through rollout planning, role-based training, and change management.
* The credibility to engage customer executives, hold stakeholders accountable, and influence cross-functional partners you don’t directly manage.

We replace broken parking machines, fragmented software, and manual, labor-intensive operations with a unified, data-rich operating system for parking real estate. We handle everything it takes to run and optimize a parking asset: payments, dynamic pricing, enforcement, license plate recognition, analytics, and more.

By building all of our technology in-house, we are able to deliver a magical experience for drivers while providing real-time visibility and revenue increases of 20-50% or more for real estate owners. We’re investing aggressively to make the physical world legible to a digital system: cameras, sensors, and software that generate a firehose of real-time data about the world around us. We have two home visiting models:

* Family Model: Helps parents support their children's learning and development through play, books, and everyday interactions.

* Home-Based Child Care Model: Helps home-based child care providers create engaging learning environments for young children.

Your job is to coordinate and co-lead training opportunities for new ParentChild+ Family Model Coordinators and Home Visitors as they prepare to launch a new site. You'll also manage the process of helping new Family Model sites get started from initial planning through onboarding and training.

You'll work closely with our other National Center teams to make sure your training and onboarding run smoothly and that new sites have the support they need to succeed.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager (Captain of Go-Live)
jobs.description:
Do you feel more in your element, not less, when a project has six stakeholders, three departments, and a deadline that actually matters to someone's budget? Can you read an RFP or a draft SOW and spot the commitment that will blow up month four of an implementation before anyone has signed anything? Do you get more satisfaction from watching your team land a go-live than from landing it yourself? Can you spot a risk quietly building across two different workstreams, or across five people's portfolios, before anyone else notices it? Do you already reach for AI to move faster through complex data and document work, and coach your team to do the same? Are you the person other teams call when an enterprise account needs someone steady at the helm? If so, keep reading...

The team at RTA is looking for an Implementation Manager: our Enterprise Orchestrator, Team Coach, and Fleet360 Authority all rolled into one. Reporting to the CTO, you'll lead RTA's implementation team of enterprise and non-enterprise Implementation Specialists. You'll own the delivery of every customer onboarding from signed contract through a confident go-live.

You'll hire, coach, and hold accountable the specialists who run every engagement, and step in as the escalation point when an enterprise account needs a steady hand. Your work starts before the contract is signed. You'll partner with Sales during the enterprise pre-sales process to review RFPs, SOWs, and contract language, so that what we promise is something we can actually deliver. You'll coordinate across Sales, Fleet Consulting, Training, Support, and CSM (Customer Success Management), catch risk across the whole portfolio before it threatens a timeline, and make sure every customer arrives at go-live confident, not just converted. This position plays a direct role in RTA's mission to help fleets succeed, starting with the customers who trust us with the most.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

In general, someone who:

* Feels at home being a member of a healthy team. This means they aren't afraid to mix it up or be held accountable by the team, and they are willing to hold others accountable as well. People with trust issues and insecurity need not apply. No, seriously.
* Passionately cares about our clients and helping them be more successful. Our clients are fleet managers, parts clerks, and automotive technicians who maintain everything from squad cars to school buses so that everyone comes home safely at the end of the day.
* Thinks of themselves less, while not thinking less of themselves. They are other-centric, compassionate, and self-assured.
* Is willing to lift boxes, clean floors, and hold doors if that's what it takes to get something done, because no job is beneath them.
* Takes ownership and initiative. They identify how to make processes better without waiting to be told, and practice Extreme Ownership when things go sideways.
* Loves to read, learn, grow, and stretch themselves through goal setting and daily habits. Bonus points for each book you've read by Patrick Lencioni.
* Wants to be part of a leadership team that constantly challenges and stretches each other's abilities. We don't do echo chambers here.

**Specifically for This Role, Someone Who:**
--------------------------------------------

**Leads and develops the team**

* Has led and managed an implementation, onboarding, or professional services team for a software product, and loves helping others excel in their work.
* Sets clear expectations, runs effective 1:1s, gives direct feedback early, and creates a culture where people grow and do their best work. Part coach, part bulldozer: you seek and destroy the obstacles blocking your team.
* Holds specialists accountable to timelines, quality, and scope, and has the hard conversation when performance isn't there, rather than quietly absorbing the work yourself.
* Recruits, onboards, and retains strong implementers, and builds onboarding plans that get new specialists running implementations on their own quickly.
* Balances workload across the team: assigns new engagements based on capacity and complexity, and sees an overloaded portfolio before it becomes a missed go-live.
* Understands the value of metrics, knows what to track and how to track it, and makes staffing, process, and tooling decisions from the data.

**Reviews enterprise documents before the deal is signed**

* Partners with Sales during the enterprise pre-sales process, reviewing RFPs, SOWs, contracts, and statements of requirements for implementation scope, timeline, data migration, integration, and staffing commitments.
* Reads requirement language line by line and flags anything vague, unrealistic, or out of scope, then proposes the language that fixes it before it becomes a commitment we have to keep.
* Contributes the implementation sections of RFP responses and SOWs: approach, timeline, roles, assumptions, and customer responsibilities.
* Turns the signed documents into the implementation plan, so the team delivers against what was actually contracted, not what someone remembers from the sales call.

**Owns enterprise delivery**

* Owns timeline and sequencing across the team's full implementation portfolio.
* Coordinates explicitly across Sales, Fleet Consulting, Training, Support, and CSM at defined handoff points, keeping every team's commitments visible instead of assumed.
* Proactively surfaces risk, including cross-departmental dependencies that are quietly stalling, and brings a mitigation plan instead of just a flag.
* Guides customers, including senior fleet and operations leaders, through high-stakes configuration decisions with enough credibility that they trust your judgment, not just your process.
* Builds confidence with enterprise customers by communicating proactively, setting clear expectations, and creating trust long before issues ever arise. You are the escalation point when a customer relationship gets tense.
* Holds the agreed scope line with customers, knowing when a variation needs documentation, an addendum, or a real escalation, and coaches the team to do the same.
* Owns data migration quality across the team. You can clean, compile, and migrate data into Fleet360 yourself, and you're comfortable with nested formulas, multi-condition logic, and multi-tab interconnected workbooks. You also set the standard and review the work so migration errors don't reach go-live.
* Builds and refines implementation processes, playbooks, and templates that scale as the enterprise pipeline grows.
* Operates with an AI-first mindset and makes the team AI-first too: using AI to speed up document review, data analysis, customer communication, and project execution, while knowing exactly when human judgment is required. This one is not optional here.

RTA's biggest customers carry the most people, the most vehicles, and the most on the line if something falls through the cracks. You're the one making sure your whole team holds it together, from the first RFP question to the last go-live checklist item. Are you the reason it comes together instead of falling apart? Let's find out.

**This Role Probably Is Not for You if...**
-------------------------------------------

* You want to manage from a dashboard. You'll be in the RFPs, the escalation calls, and the data reviews alongside your team.
* You'd rather be the best implementer than build a team of them. Your success is measured by the team's go-lives, not your own.
* You avoid hard conversations. Holding a specialist accountable, or telling Sales that an RFP commitment isn't deliverable, is part of the job.
* You think contracts and RFPs are Sales' problem. If you'd rather find out what we promised at kickoff, this isn't your role.
* You want one team and one clear lane. This role coordinates Sales, Fleet Consulting, Training, Support, and CSM across every engagement, often all at once.
* You wait for someone else to flag risk. If a dependency or a specialist's portfolio is quietly stalling, naming it and building the mitigation plan is your job.
* You treat scope creep as a later problem. On accounts this size, an undocumented variation can turn into real financial or timeline exposure fast.
* You think using AI is cutting corners, or you're waiting for someone else to figure out how it fits your job. At RTA, that's not a personality quirk. It's a mismatch with the role.

**Key Results Areas (aka the Job Outcomes)**
--------------------------------------------

* Hit the agreed go-live date on at least 90% of the team's engagements each quarter, with at-risk timelines surfaced with a mitigation plan at least 2 weeks before they slip.
* Review 100% of enterprise RFPs, SOWs, and contracts for implementation commitments before submission or signature, returning comments to Sales within 3 business days.
* Zero signed enterprise commitments for implementation scope, timeline, or staffing that the team can't deliver as written.
* Maintain a customer satisfaction rating of 90% or higher across the team's completed implementations each quarter.
* Zero downstream data-quality escalations traced back to migration error, across the team.
* Log 100% of customer scope variations in the account record, escalating any that require an addendum within 2 business days of identification.
* Achieve 95% completion of internal implementation milestones on or before committed dates, so downstream teams receive clean, complete handoffs.
* Build and retain a high-performing team: low regrettable attrition, a documented development plan for every specialist, and new hires running implementations on their own within 90 days.
* Put at least one new AI-assisted workflow into practice across the team each quarter that measurably speeds up document review, data work, customer communication, or troubleshooting.

**Qualifications**
------------------

OK, the boring HR part of the job posting that looks like every other posting out there, but it's necessary:

* 7+ years in customer-facing implementation, onboarding, professional services, or project management roles; B2B SaaS (Software as a Service) strongly preferred
* 2+ years directly managing people, ideally a team of 4 or more implementers, consultants, or project managers
* Hands-on experience reviewing RFPs, SOWs, MSAs (Master Service Agreements), or similar contract documents for delivery scope and risk; public sector procurement experience a strong plus
* Track record leading complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise implementations from kickoff through go-live
* Proficient with Microsoft 365, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint, with comfort in nested formulas, multi-condition logic, and multi-tab interconnected workbooks
* Experience with project/ticket tracking tools (e.g., JIRA) and CRM (Customer Relationship Management) tools (e.g., HubSpot)
* Comfortable leading conversations with senior fleet and operations leaders, including high-stakes configuration decisions and scope pushback
* Demonstrated, real-world use of AI tools to increase speed or accuracy in your own work and your team's, with specific examples you can speak to
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you write clearly enough that your redlines and comments don't need a follow-up meeting
* Fleet, fleet-adjacent, or public sector operations experience preferred, not required. We define this broadly:  
  + Direct fleet or asset operations: fleet manager, shop supervisor, maintenance coordinator, or municipal, school, and EMS fleet operations
  + Fleet-adjacent industries: transportation and logistics, public works, construction or utilities equipment, waste management
  + Fleet-adjacent software: implementation or onboarding experience with other fleet, asset, or maintenance management platforms
* Exposure to SQL (Structured Query Language) or structured databases preferred, not required
* Bachelor's degree not required. Relevant experience and breadth of knowledge matter more

Nick Fury never threw a punch. He assembled the team, coordinated the moving parts, and made sure everyone showed up in the right place at the right time. Think you can do that for an entire implementation team? Prove it.

**The Bottom Line**
-------------------

You've made it this far, congratulations. We're looking for an ideal team player with an almost frightening intensity around orchestration, credibility, and follow-through. That means someone who can build a team that holds six-team engagements together without losing sight of a single open item, and who catches the bad commitment in the RFP before it ever reaches the team. If you feel a quiet thrill when a complicated account lands exactly where it's supposed to, on time and without drama, and even more when your team lands it, we want to talk.

**Compensation & Work Location**
--------------------------------

* Total compensation for this role is between $120,000 and $135,000 based on experience.
* This is a full-time, fully remote-eligible role, including for candidates based in the Phoenix metro area.
* First week onboarding onsite at RTA HQ in Glendale, AZ required.
* Occasional visits to RTA HQ for team events should be expected.
* Travel to customer sites for pre-sales meetings, kickoffs, and go-lives is up to 10% annually, based on business needs.
* This position is classified as exempt and is not eligible for overtime pay.

**Why Top Talent Chooses RTA**
------------------------------

We invest in our people — period.

* 401(k) with 6% Safe Harbor match (100% vested day one)
* Flexible PTO model built on trust and manager-approved time off
* Cigna PPO and HSA medical plan options with company contributions ($780–$1,950 annually)
* Garner Health HRA program: up to $1,000 individual / $2,000 family reimbursement opportunity
* Wellness rewards up to $350 annually
* Virtual care and mental health support resources
* Company-sponsored benefits including dental, vision, EAP, life, STD, LTD, legal plan, and identity theft protection options
* Additional employee perks, wellness initiatives, and discount programs

**The Part We're Most Proud Of**
--------------------------------

* 99% of employees say RTA is a Great Place to Work® (Certified 3 years running)
* 30% ARR growth — two years straight
* We are an AI-forward company building for the future
* We see you. You have been reading this for seven minutes. Just apply already.

**About Us**
------------

RTA has been established since 1979 and has the reputation of providing the best customer service in the market. Our purpose is to help fleets succeed. We pride ourselves on creating a caring, family-oriented atmosphere for both staff and clients, and love that our work makes a positive impact on all the lives we touch. Our clients carry kids in school buses, first responders in emergency vehicles, patients in ambulances, food and medical supplies in trucks, and people just taking the bus or train to work. We do meaningful work, and we want our clients to have the best tools available to them.

Our office spaces are open, spacious, and colorful, with an abundance of natural light. We come together often as a company to enjoy freshly baked desserts or awesome lunches, and genuinely enjoy each other's company. We offer some pretty unique perks and benefits, as well as all the standard ones. We're happy to talk through all the options.

**Physical & Travel Requirements**

* Ability to work at a computer for prolonged periods
* Ability to travel up to 10%
* Ability to travel to the company headquarters for Onboarding

**Heading to RTA HQ?**
----------------------

Coming from the east side? You'll enjoy waving at the traffic going the other way while never having to stare at the blinding sun. It only takes about 25 minutes to get here from downtown Scottsdale in the mornings. We are located close to Arrowhead Mall, with quick access to the 101 from multiple directions. If all of this sounds like you, and your type of company, then click apply. Seriously, we've asked you four times now, and you are still reading. Bonus points for being thorough.

**Reasonable Accommodation**
----------------------------

**Employment Notices**
----------------------

Employment with RTA may be contingent upon successful completion of a background check and other pre-employment screenings, consistent with applicable law.

jobs.description:
**Enterprise Implementation Specialist**

**Location:** Remote (East Coast, US.)
  
**Reports to:** Director, Customer Services

**About Crossbeam**

Most go-to-market teams are still running playbooks built for a different era. More cold outreach. More ads. More noise. Crossbeam was built on a different idea: the fastest path to revenue is often through the companies already connected to your customers.

Crossbeam is the platform that makes that possible. Companies use Crossbeam to securely compare CRM data with partners, revealing shared customers, overlapping prospects, and warm paths into deals. We’re defining the category of ecosystem-led growth and giving revenue teams a fundamentally better signal for how to prioritize accounts, collaborate with partners, and win deals faster.

**About the role:**

As an Implementation Specialist on our Enterprise team, you will own the implementation journey for our largest customers (3,500+ employees), from contract close to the day their core use cases are live, and you will stay their technical advisor for the length of their contract. You will work hand in hand with Account Success Managers (ASMs), Account Executives, and our Business Development team to turn a signed contract into a long-term partnership.

**What you'll do:**

Your work is organized around 5 pillars.

* Pre-kickoff & Scoping:

* Join internal handover calls with Account Executives before (or right at) contract close, so customers never feel like discovery is starting over
* Run a client readiness review and a data governance checklist upfront: CRM setup, integration user, SSO, security requirements, internal resources and key deadlines
* Co-lead the kickoff with the ASM: present the implementation plan, timeline, and ownership

* Use-Case-First Implementation & Project Management:

* Partner with the ASM to run a strategy session that aligns on the customer's top use cases, KPIs, and priority partners, then build the implementation plan around them (not around a feature checklist)
* Run weekly working sessions with the customer's RevOps, Partnerships, and IT stakeholders, and deliver a technical go-live within a 90-day target
* Lead the technical rollout across three phases:

  + In-app and CRM setup: sandbox testing (Salesforce, HubSpot), data sources, populations, sharing settings, SSO, and user management
  + Operationalizing partner data: account mapping, report notifications, and integrations with the customer's tech stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics, Slack, Copilot, Clay, Snowflake, Gong, MCP and more)
  + Ecosystem growth: partner activation alongside our Business Development team
* Document progress, risks, and decisions in our customer success platform, and flag onboarding risk early so you can act on it together with the ASM

* Enablement & Partner Workshops:

* Scope and deliver customized enablement sessions for admins, partnership teams, sales teams, and leadership
* Run partner workshops that help customers and their partners build collaborative routines using Crossbeam reports, shared lists, and notifications
* Teach customers to be self-sufficient with our Help Center and Academy, and set expectations on how to engage Support and their ASM going forward

* Strategic Advisory & Revenue Impact:

* Act as a trusted technical advisor to admins and executive sponsors, bringing a consultative perspective on how to get more value from their ecosystem
* Hand off to the ASM with a clear picture of what's live, what's next, and where the opportunities are
* Run post-implementation account checks to catch integration issues, seat gaps, and adoption risks before they become churn risks
* Spot expansion signals and scope Professional Services engagements (custom configurations, technical rework, extra enablement or workshops) when needs go beyond standard scope

* Technical Escalation & Continuous Improvement:

* Act as the escalation point for complex technical issues on your Enterprise accounts, working with Support, Product, and Engineering to troubleshoot and resolve them
* Share product feedback from the field to influence our roadmap
* Help build and refine our Enterprise implementation processes, templates, and AI-powered workflows, and share best practices with the team

**What you'll need:**

* 2+ years in implementation or onboarding at a B2B SaaS company
* 1+ year in a customer-facing role
* Experience running technical implementations end to end, with strong project management
* Hands-on experience configuring a CRM (Salesforce or HubSpot) and its integrations
* A consultative, solution-oriented mindset
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication

**It’s a bonus if you have:**

* Experience working with Enterprise customers (3,500+ employees)
* Microsoft Dynamics experience
* Familiarity with MCP and AI tooling

**You'll do great if you:**

* Lead with outcomes, not features. You ask "what is this customer trying to achieve?" before deciding what to configure
* Are comfortable in the room with both a Salesforce admin and a VP of Partnerships, and adjust your message to each
* Protect quality. You set realistic expectations and push back (kindly and clearly) when a timeline or scope puts the customer at risk
* See every implementation call as a chance to drive adoption, reduce risk, and surface the next opportunity
* Take ownership without waiting for permission, and keep multi-stakeholder projects moving when priorities shift
* Dig until you understand the real problem, not just the surface request
* Use AI to synthesize information, prep sessions, and move faster, while knowing when a human touch matters most
* Like building the playbook as much as running it. Our Enterprise motion is evolving, and your input will shape it

**You'll get:**

* Collaborative teammates and a culture built on trust and accountability
* Competitive compensation and equity
* Comprehensive healthcare coverage for you and your family
* Remote-flexible with access to co-working spaces in your area
* Learning, wellness, and WFH stipends
* Flexible time off
* Paid parental leave
* ...and more!
